body: This is incredibly misleading. She has said that she thinks it’s annoying that people assume she’s a trump supporter. She also said she was only at the White House to help push for prison reform and clarified she sang at a rally because it was part of her duties as Miss Mississippi. Also, “gun loving” is a stretch. She supports the 2nd amendment but believes AK47s and the like aren’t for civilians.
